methods.name: ML-LaDeCORsat (Machine Learning-based coseismic Landslide Detection using Combined Optical and Radar Satellite Imagery)
methods.summary: A machine learning-based approach implemented in Google Earth Engine that integrates optical (Sentinel-2) and radar (Sentinel-1, PALSAR-2) imagery with topographic data. It uses a landslide-specific sampling strategy and a machine learning classifier (e.g., Gradient Tree Boost) to classify pixels as landslide or non-landslide.
methods.verbatim: This study proposes a novel approach, the ML-LaDeCORsat (Machine Learning-based coseismic Landslide Detection using Combined Optical and Radar Satellite Imagery), that integrates freely available Sentinel-1, Palsar-2, and Sentinel-2 imagery data in Google Earth Engine (GEE). ... Publicly available Google Earth Engine (GEE) scripts and datasets develop and used in this study can be found in the following GEE repository: https://code.earthengine.google.com/?accept_repo=users/speterstum/ML_LaDeCORSat

code_links.name: Previously existing landslide detection methods implemented in GEE for comparison
code_links.summary: Other established landslide detection methods, reimplemented and validated in GEE for comparison against the proposed ML-LaDeCORsat method, as presented in Table 1 and Figure 7.
